hero.supporting: Multisite SaaS for independent retailers: one admin, several storefronts, shared catalog and stock — in-store and online from day one.
problem.title: Two tools, one shop
problem.lead: Most local merchants juggle a till, a website, and spreadsheets. Stock and customer data never stay in sync.
problem.point1.title: Split catalog
problem.point1.body: Products updated in the shop do not appear online — or the reverse. Every channel becomes a separate maintenance job.
problem.point2.title: Invisible stock
problem.point2.body: Click & collect and in-store sales need a single stock view. Without it, overselling and manual checks pile up.
problem.point3.title: Heavy admin
problem.point3.body: Managing several brands or locations means repeating the same work in disconnected tools.
solution.title: One console, several storefronts
solution.lead: Mestryx Platform centralises administration while each site keeps its own brand, domain, and SEO-ready storefront.
solution.point1.title: Multisite admin
solution.point1.body: Organisations, sites, products, and orders from a single SPA — scoped by tenant with strict isolation.
solution.point2.title: SSR storefront
solution.point2.body: Public shops are server-rendered for search engines and AI discovery: metadata, sitemap, structured data.
solution.point3.title: Omnichannel path
solution.point3.body: Start with ecommerce and unified stock; add click & collect after launch; full POS is explicitly later.
roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.phase.mvp.label: MVP — now
roadmap.phase.mvp.description: Landing, live demos, admin and storefront for seed merchants, checkout in pending-payment mode.
roadmap.phase.clickCollect.label: Click & collect
roadmap.phase.clickCollect.description: Shared stock between web and pickup — lightweight store fulfilment without a full cash register.
roadmap.phase.ae.label: AE — September 2026
roadmap.phase.ae.description: Micro-enterprise registration, legal pages finalised, first paying merchants after counsel validation.
roadmap.phase.pos.label: POS — later
roadmap.phase.pos.description: In-store till integration deferred; omnichannel pitch today, cash-register depth when the merchant base is ready.

Depending on your actions, we may process:

• Improve the product and prepare commercial launch (CRE / AE 2026).

• Consent: analytics cookies (Umami) — you may refuse or withdraw consent at any time via cookie preferences.
• Pre-contractual measures / contract: answering contact messages related to a potential service.
legal.privacy.section.retention.title: Retention
legal.privacy.section.retention.body:
• Server logs: limited duration (typically up to 12 months unless a security incident requires longer retention).
• Umami analytics: aggregated event data retained according to our self-hosted instance policy (typically up to 24 months).
• Contact emails: retained for the time needed to handle your request and any follow-up, then archived or deleted.

No routine transfer outside the European Economic Area is planned; if this changes, this notice will be updated.
legal.privacy.section.rights.title: Your rights
